ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels in central lobe regions and 25% low-intensity black pixels localized at the margins and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions in central lobes; dark pigment band along trailing edge and leading edges; discrete dark circular spot on left lobe (approx. mid-distal); dense black mottling around the median notch and inner lobe boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximately 40-degree angle with a deep vertical recession relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks increases significantly towards the distal tips, creating a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, which exhibit a sharp upward vertical sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast white/grey pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; single dark circular focal anomaly on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) on the interior right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; irregular tissue loss along trailing edge resulting in a jagged, non-linear profile; multiple rake marks on the right ventral surface.
